_comment: Shared case file of the embedded shell-out readers (#779): scripts/hooks/destructive-gate.py embedded_commands and scripts/hooks/lib/heredoc-program.mjs embeddedCommands (child-claude guard, bash egress gate). commands = the shell commands a code payload of cmd (python/node/perl/ruby -c/-e, interpreter heredoc or here-string, `| python3 -`) hands to a shell through a known shell-out call (os.system, subprocess.*, os.exec*/spawn*, pty.spawn, child_process.*, perl/ruby system/exec/backticks), in order. COVERAGE (Marveen msg 17385): literal arguments only. A string built at run time (concatenation, f-string with a variable, a variable, base64, `bash <<< "$(...)"`) is a KNOWN LIMIT: those entries carry a note, and commands shows what is read (never the hidden command). Benign negatives (name neg/...): the same words as plain data (print, log, dict, doc string, file write) give []. Checked by scripts/__tests__/heredoc-program.test.py and src/__tests__/heredoc-program-parity.test.ts.
